HELPERHUB.AutoHint: Play the selected transition when switching to a scene that has no transition type of its own.
HELPERHUB.ForceHint: Use the selected transition even when the scene already has a transition type. Automatic mode must also be enabled.
HELPERHUB.DurationHint: Duration, in milliseconds, used when this module injects a scene transition.
HELPERHUB.IntensityHint: Shared strength from zero to one. TV static: interference. Smoke: density and drift. Spinner: arc thickness and glow. Whip pan: blur and letterbox height. Custom mask: edge softness.
HELPERHUB.VolumeHint: Volume of the synthesized static hiss. Zero mutes it. Multiplied by the global ambient volume. Plays only during the TV static transition.
HELPERHUB.TransitionHint: Transition played when this module injects a scene change. The list includes the effects added here and the core scene transitions.
HELPERHUB.CustomFileHint: Image or video for the Custom Animation transition. Videos can be mp4, webm, ogv, or m4v. GIF and APNG do not play frame by frame; upload a video instead. Mask mode uses the brightness of the frame: dark keeps the old scene and light reveals the new one.
HELPERHUB.CustomModeHint: Play shows the file over the scene change. Mask uses its brightness to reveal the new scene.
HELPERHUB.CustomMissing: The custom transition file is missing or cannot be played. The scene will fade instead.
HELPERHUB.ChatImagesHint: Upload image files dropped onto the chat log and post them as a message.
HELPERHUB.ChatLinksHint: Turn an image or YouTube link pasted or dropped into chat into a card.
HELPERHUB.PlaylistYouTubeHint: Allow YouTube links to be added to playlists and played in place of the silent placeholder.
HELPERHUB.DropNotImage: Only image files can be dropped into chat.
HELPERHUB.DropNoPermission: You do not have permission to upload files.
HELPERHUB.DropPostFailed: The images uploaded, but the chat message could not be posted.
HELPERHUB.LinkPostFailed: The link could not be posted to chat.
HELPERHUB.DropBusy: An image upload is already in progress.
HELPERHUB.DropUrlUnsupported: Only an image or YouTube link can be dropped into chat.
HELPERHUB.PlaylistNotYouTube: That link is not a YouTube video.
